A previous attempt at this task failed. The lesson from that attempt:
After opening OsmAnd, tap the search icon (magnifying glass) to open the search screen. Type "Malbun, Liechtenstein" in the search field, then tap the correct search result that shows Malbun on the map. Do not re-enter text or scroll after selecting a result—that returns you to search. Once the map centers on Malbun, long-press directly on the map (not on any button or list item) to drop a marker. If a context menu appears, choose "Add marker" or the marker option. Avoid clicking random indices; use visible labels.
